name: Highland Cow Retractable Nurse Badge Reel
seoTitle: Highland Cow Nurse Badge Reel Gift
metaDescription: A fluffy highland cow badge reel for nurses, CNAs, and students who love farm animals. A charming, budget friendly gift they will clip on every shift.
summary: A shaggy highland cow on a badge reel is a charming little gift for the nurse who decorates everything with cows, from mugs to scrub caps.
whyItWorks: Highland cows have become a favorite for a lot of nurses, showing up on scrub caps, tumblers, and lockers. If you know someone who lights up at a fluffy cow, a badge reel lets them carry that joy into every shift. It is one of the most visible accessories a nurse wears, pulled out every time a door or charting station asks for a badge.

Small character reels also make patients smile, which is a real bonus on pediatric floors or in long term care where residents enjoy a bit of whimsy. For buyers, it is an easy win for Secret Santa, a unit gift exchange, or a just because treat for a nurse who had a rough week. It slips into a card or a holiday stocking with no trouble. If the nurse already has a cow themed collection, this fits right in, and if they do not, it might start one.
goodToKnow: Check the listing for the clip type and cord length before ordering.
Pair it with a highland cow mug or tumbler for a themed gift set.
The title also mentions teachers, MAs, and CNAs, so it works beyond nursing.

faq.q: Is this a good Secret Santa gift for a nurse?
faq.a: Yes. It is small, inexpensive, and something nearly every nurse uses daily, which makes it a safe and fun gift exchange pick.

faq.q: Will it hold a hospital ID badge?
faq.a: Badge reels are made for standard ID cards. If the nurse carries several cards, check the listing for how much the reel can handle.
